human_review.governing_policy: docs/contracts/COMPATIBILITY_POLICY.md section 3.1 ("generator bug fixes producing semantically identical models" / "correction of invalid examples without changing valid instance semantics")
human_review.rationale: The raw checker classifies every change above as major (reference_target_changed / property_removed+property_added on components.schemas keys), its correct, conservative, mechanical default for any structural /key change. Checkpoint 1J proved directly, by execution, that the 8 old component names these changes replace never resolved to any existing schema in the canonical document at all (a genuine invalid-artifact defect, not a valid prior contract) -- confirmed via Schemathesis attempting to load the document and failing with a real "component does not exist" resolution error. No consumer (0 found in a full-repository search: no internal code, no generated client, no evidenced external consumer) could ever have validly depended on the broken names. The schema BODIES referenced by both the old (broken) and new (repaired) names are byte-for-byte identical -- verified directly via git diff of packages/contracts/generated/openapi/service-components.json, which shows only the 8 key lines changing, nothing else within any schema object. This is squarely "a generator bug fix producing a semantically identical model," the policy's own explicit patch-compatible carve-out -- not a change to any service's actual accepted/rejected input or output shape.
human_review.scope_confirmation: Defect B (400/402 response-schema mismatch) is explicitly NOT included in this release -- verified unchanged from 1.0.0 (StructuredError declarations, 400/402 response schemas byte-identical). Defect B remains a separate, not-yet-authorized MAJOR_CONTRACT_RELEASE decision per checkpoint 1J.
human_review.raw_checker_classification_note: required_version_bump above (major) is the raw, unmodified checker output -- preserved for transparency, not edited or suppressed. This human_review field is the governance-required override record (COMPATIBILITY_POLICY.md section 12: human approval required for major classifications), not a replacement of the raw evidence.
